The Atomic Pro Sirio ArchBar 1000 LED bar is a spectacular lighting system powered by 672 RGBW LEDs and 112 cold white LEDs. Among the innovations that make the ArchBar 1000 unique is the ability to divide both the RGBW LEDs and the white LEDs into different groups for DMX control. Moreover, thanks to Atomic Pro’s new technology, you can apply a frost filter linearly with different intensities via DMX, without adding external filters.
